BLD-0001.evidence_requirement: Cite the exact transcript glob and the number of tool_use records parsed. The extractor script path and its sha256 go in the receipt so the ledger is reproducible. DETECTOR CONTROL IS MANDATORY: seed one KNOWN-READ file (any path cited file:line by an existing receipt) and prove it is absent from the unread set, and seed one KNOWN-UNREAD sentinel path and prove it appears. A low or zero unread count with no control is a detector failure, not a clean bill.
inputs: ~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl (session + subagent transcripts for this program)
`git ls-files` at the program HEAD of C:/Users/Prekzursil/source/ast-integrate
command-center/ARTIFACT-MANIFEST.json
command-center/PROGRAM-CHARTER.md (the declared scope statement)
BLD-0001.question_or_target: Question: which files inside the program's declared scope did NO agent ever open? Build a read-ledger by extracting every Read/Grep/Glob/Bash-cat tool_use input path from the session JSONL transcripts for the whole Prompt Two program, normalise each to a repo-relative path, and set-difference the ledger against `git ls-files` at the program HEAD. Emit an unread-file register carrying a criticality weight (executable > schema > CI config > doc > fixture) and a per-file reason code (out-of-scope | never-routed | oversized | unreadable-form).  [Phase 13 question answered: what files were never read]
BLD-0001.retry_policy: No blind retry: re-running the same extractor is not a second signal. A disagreeing second extractor is a detector defect - fix and re-run once; a second disagreement escalates with both outputs attached.
BLD-0001.reviewer_requirement: One independent reviewer who re-derives the unread count with a mechanically different extractor (jq over the JSONL rather than the Python parser) and must agree within 1% or the discrepancy blocks.
tests_required: Control (known-present): a file cited file:line in an existing receipt must NOT appear in the unread set.
Control (known-absent): a planted sentinel path present in git but touched by nobody must appear in the unread set.
Path-form collapse: the same file reached as C:/..., /c/..., .\rel\path and repo-relative must produce exactly ONE ledger entry.
Determinism: two runs over the same frozen transcript set must emit byte-identical registers.
BLD-0001.title: Never-read file census derived from the transcript read-ledger

BLD-0002.evidence_requirement: State the entry-point set explicitly and cite each source at file:line - an incomplete entry-point set manufactures false unreachability, which is the dangerous direction here (it invites deletion). Every unreachable verdict must survive a dynamic-import search (importlib, __import__, entry_points, plugin discovery by glob) before it is reported.
inputs: the shipped package tree produced by B07
plugin manifest + hook manifest + MCP tool registrations (entry-point declarations)
the CI workflow files (the commands CI actually invokes)
coverage.xml from the B08 suite run (for the covered-but-unreachable cross-check)
BLD-0002.question_or_target: Question: which shipped modules and public functions are unreachable from ANY declared entry point? Build a static import/call graph over the shipped package, mark entry points from the plugin manifest commands, the hook manifest registrations, the MCP tool exports, the workflow stage registry and the CI invocation lines, compute reachability, and emit the unreachable set. This is orthogonal to line coverage: code can be imported and covered by a test yet be reachable from no user-facing entry point at all.  SCOPE BOUNDARY: AUD-0032 censuses unreferenced modules and dead code. This unit consumes that receipt and contributes ENTRY-POINT reachability, which is a different question - a module can be referenced by a test and still be reachable from no CLI command, hook registration or MCP export. Report only the delta.  [Phase 13 question answered: what files were never read]
BLD-0002.retry_policy: Two strikes then pivot: a second false-positive class means the graph builder is wrong; switch to a runtime import-trace before a third static attempt.
BLD-0002.reviewer_requirement: One independent reviewer who attempts to reach three sampled 'unreachable' symbols from a real CLI invocation before sign-off.
tests_required: Control: a deliberately orphaned module planted in a scratch copy must be reported unreachable.
Control (false-positive guard): a module reachable ONLY through a hook manifest entry must NOT be reported - this proves the entry-point set includes hooks.
Control (dynamic import): a module loaded only via importlib.import_module(name_from_config) must NOT be reported unreachable.
Cross-check: every file that is covered by tests but unreachable from an entry point must be individually explained in the register.
BLD-0002.title: Unreachable-code census by import-graph reachability from declared entry points

BLD-0006.evidence_requirement: A RUN cell without a client version string is downgraded to NEVER-RUN. inputs: the compatibility matrix produced in Phase 4
the conformance suite from B08
installed client versions on this box (read-only probe)
command-center/receipts/** (the evidence anchors)
BLD-0006.question_or_target: Question: which supported host client was never exercised end-to-end? SCOPE BOUNDARY: TST-0049 executes the compatibility-matrix conformance tests and ARC-0095 defines how an untested cell is represented. This unit contributes the EVIDENCE-QUALITY audit of the filled matrix: a cell may read RUN only on an observation from inside the client, never on an installer exit code.  [Phase 13 question answered: what clients were never tested]
BLD-0006.retry_policy: No retry on an absent client: report NOT-CHECKED with the exact install step that would enable the probe.
BLD-0006.reviewer_requirement: One independent reviewer who re-runs one RUN cell on a client the original agent did not use.
tests_required: Both-states: deliberately corrupt the plugin manifest and prove every RUN cell's probe turns red on that client - a probe that passes against a broken manifest measures nothing.
Control: a cell whose only evidence is an installer exit code must fail validation.
Control: an absent client must classify NOT-CHECKED, never PASS and never NOT-APPLICABLE.
BLD-0006.title: Host-client coverage matrix with a version-stamped evidence anchor per cell

BLD-0044.evidence_requirement: The egress block must itself be controlled: prove a deliberate download attempt FAILS under the block before any green result under it is trusted. A green suite under an unproven block measures nothing.
inputs: the full test suite
the CNF-0147 egress-blocked confirmation-suite receipt (consumed, not re-derived)
the egress-blocking harness
the cache directories the suite touches
BLD-0044.question_or_target: Question: which test's outcome depends on an input nobody declared? Re-run the suite under randomized test order, a different PRNG seed, a shifted timezone, a different working directory, a cold cache, and with network egress BLOCKED; report every test whose result changes. The estate measured 14 tests silently downloading a bootstrap script despite comments asserting they never download. SCOPE BOUNDARY: CNF-0147 runs the egress-blocked re-run over the CONFIRMATION suite; this unit consumes that receipt and contributes the multi-axis CROSS-PRODUCT over the full suite - order x seed x timezone x cwd x cache - in which egress is one column rather than the deliverable.  [Phase 13 question answered: what test could falsely pass]
BLD-0044.retry_policy: Two strikes then pivot: after two blocker-setup failures, run the suite inside a network-isolated container rather than attempting a third host-level block.
BLD-0044.reviewer_requirement: One independent reviewer who repeats the egress-blocked run and confirms both the block control and the failure list.
tests_required: Block control: a deliberate fetch must fail under the egress block (both-states proof for the blocker itself).
Order: at least two distinct random seeds must be used; a test that passes under one order and fails under another is reported.
Cache: a cold-cache run must be compared against a warm-cache run and any divergence reported.
Control: a genuinely hermetic test must pass identically in all environments (no false positives).
BLD-0044.title: Nondeterminism and hidden-input census under randomized order, seed, TZ, cwd and blocked egress

BLD-0045.evidence_requirement: Coverage must be collected WITH branch coverage enabled; a run without it cannot see the regression this unit exists to find. Report per-region assertion dependency, not a global percentage.
inputs: branch-enabled coverage output from the B08 suite
the shipped source tree
the rollback and error-handling code paths specifically
BLD-0045.question_or_target: Question: which lines are executed by the suite but whose behaviour nothing asserts? Report high-coverage, zero-assertion regions and concentrate the analysis on error handling and rollback paths, where coverage most often means 'executed while nobody looked'.  [Phase 13 question answered: what test could falsely pass]
BLD-0045.retry_policy: Two strikes then pivot from static assertion-dependency inference to mutation of the specific region before a third attempt.
BLD-0045.reviewer_requirement: One independent reviewer who deletes the assertion from one covered region and confirms the audit reclassifies it.
tests_required: Control: a function called only for its side effect with no assertion must be reported.
Control: a function whose return value feeds an assert must NOT be reported.
Control: an except-branch that is covered but whose effect is never asserted must be reported (this is the concentration target).
Instrument control: prove branch coverage is actually on by observing a partial-branch entry in the report.
BLD-0045.title: Covered-but-unasserted code audit, concentrated on error and rollback paths
